properties.title: Flood Advisory issued October 19 at 3:06PM ChST until October 19 at 6:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Guam...

* WHEN...Until 600 PM ChST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 304 PM ChST, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to heavy
showers and thunderstorms approaching from the south. This will
cause urban and small stream flooding, starting with southern
Guam.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dededo, Tamuning, Yigo, Mangilao, Chalan Pago-Ordot, Barrigada,
Yona, Hagatna Heights, Andersen AFB, Talofofo,
Mongmong-Toto-Maite, Sinajana, Inarajan, Asan, Merizo, Piti,
Santa Rita and Umatac.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 18 at 8:58PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Northeast winds are causing river levels on the St Johns at Astor to
rise through Minor Flood Stage. The river is forecast to reach
Moderate Flood Stage early Monday, and remain in this stage through
the end of this week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated. At 3.0 feet, Water
approaches or may enter lowest homes on or near Wildhog Road and
nearby canals. Flooding reaches the parking lot of the Juno Trail
Apartments. Flooding on portions of Alligator Road and Holiday
Road. Lowest lying yards along Blue Creek are flooded. Roads at
Astor Landing Campground and Lake Dexter Boat Ramp begin to flood.
Water enters lower homes closest to the river on McPherson Lane. At
3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on or near
Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with several
inches of water inside homes along the river and canals. Docks at
Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely submerged.
Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with yards
completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads flooded
in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on Juno
Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 2.9 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Sunday was 2.9 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to 3.3 feet early this
week following a period of persistent northeasterly winds.
Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Monday afternoon at noon EDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 18 at 8:57PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Georgia...

Satilla River At Atkinson affecting Brantley County.

Additional information is available at
https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX

The next statement will be issued Monday evening at 900 PM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Satilla River at Atkinson.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, Warners Landing, Louis Landing and
secondary roads around KOA campgrounds begin to flood. At 14.0
feet, River Rock Road begins to experience flooding across the
road.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:45 PM EDT Sunday the stage was 14.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 14.2 feet
tomorrow morning.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 8:39AM CDT until October 19 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Advisory continues for the following rivers in Texas...
Oklahoma...

Red River near Burkburnett affecting Wichita, Cotton, Tillman,
Jefferson and Clay Counties.

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Red River near Burkburnett.

* WHEN...Until Monday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet, Near bankfull conditions extend along the
Red River near Davidson... Oklahoma downstream to areas near
Burkburnett and Taylor... Oklahoma.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 AM CDT Thursday the stage was 2.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 9.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 7.7 feet
Saturday evening.
- Action stage is 7.0 feet.
- Flood stage is 9.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 845 PM CDT.
